name: Mini Photo Editor
tagline: Crop, rotate and filter a photo — right on your device.
description:
Open a picture or take one. Drag a corner to crop. Rotate, flip, pick a look — Vintage, Polaroid, Kodak, Browni — and turn bright, contrast, sat, warmth and vignette. Download keeps a JPEG here. The picture never leaves this device.

This is not a drawing app and not a compressor. It is the crop / rotate / filter loop.

The last picture and the last recipe come back the next time you open the app. Press Invite (the GifOS bar) and a friend gets your sliders and look, not your photo.

An unofficial port of mini-photo-editor by xdadda.
